application_credentials.description: SolarEdge Site Access uses OAuth 2.0. Sign in to the [SolarEdge developer console]({developer_console}) with your mySolarEdge account, create a Site Access application with the SITE_DATA and DEVICE_DATA scopes, and set its Redirect URI to exactly `{redirect_url}` (SolarEdge always redirects to the registered URL, and Home Assistant must be reachable at it from your browser; it is built from your external URL, or your internal URL if none is set). Enter the Client ID and the Client Secret (shown only once) here. The [Homeowner and Self-Access Guide]({self_access_guide}) walks through each screen.

user.title: Choose the SolarEdge access type
user.description: Homeowners use Site Access (OAuth). Installers and fleet owners with a Fleet Access application use an App API Key. V1 site API keys do not work with V2.

site.title: SolarEdge site
site.description: SolarEdge did not report which site you approved. Enter the Site ID you approved on the consent screen; it is the number in the monitoring portal address.

data_description.site_id: The numeric SolarEdge Monitoring site ID.

api_key.title: Fleet Access App API Key
api_key.description: Create a Fleet Access application in the SolarEdge developer console and paste its App API Key. The key is shown only once.

data_description.api_key: Sent as the X-API-Key header; it is never placed in a URL.

data_description.site_id: Each site is a separate entry. Add the integration again for another site.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate SolarEdge site {site_id}
reauth_confirm.description: SolarEdge rejected the stored credentials for site {site_id}. For Site Access, submit to sign in and approve again. For Fleet Access, enter a new App API Key.

data_description.api_key: A Fleet Access App API Key that can read site {site_id}.

reconfigure.title: Replace credentials for site {site_id}
reconfigure.description: For Site Access, submit to sign in and approve again. For Fleet Access, enter the new App API Key.

data_description.api_key: A Fleet Access App API Key that can read site {site_id}.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the SolarEdge API.
error.site_forbidden: These credentials cannot read this site. Check the Site ID and the scopes granted.
error.credit_limit: The developer account has used its monthly API credits.
error.no_sites: The API key has access to no sites.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The credentials belong to a different site.
abort.missing_credentials: Add application credentials (the Client ID and Client Secret of your SolarEdge Site Access application) first.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured. Follow the documentation.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timeout while generating an authorization URL.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url}).
abort.oauth_failed: Error while obtaining the access token.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timeout while resolving the OAuth token.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: OAuth authorization error while obtaining the access token.
abort.oauth_site_forbidden: The new authorization does not cover this site. Approve the same site again.
abort.oauth_cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the SolarEdge API.
abort.oauth_credit_limit: The developer account has used its monthly API credits.

init.title: Polling and credits
init.description: Every API call costs one credit. The Free tier allows 2,000 credits a month; the defaults use about 1,860 in a 30-day month for one site.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often production, consumption, and power are read. Each update costs two credits, plus one per device family when telemetry is on.
data_description.device_telemetry: Add inverter, meter, and battery sensors. Costs up to three extra credits per update and needs the DEVICE_DATA scope.

auth_failed.message: SolarEdge rejected the stored credentials; reauthentication is required.

credit_limit.message: The SolarEdge developer account has used its monthly API credits.

rate_limited.message: The SolarEdge API per-minute call limit was reached.

update_failed.message: Error communicating with the SolarEdge API: {error}

credit_limit.title: SolarEdge monthly API credits used up
credit_limit.description: SolarEdge refused updates for site {site_id} because the developer account has no monthly credits left. Updates retry every six hours and resume when the billing cycle resets. To avoid this, raise the update interval or turn off per-device telemetry in the integration options, or move the developer account to a higher tier.

device_scope_missing.title: SolarEdge device telemetry not permitted
device_scope_missing.description: SolarEdge refused device telemetry for site {site_id}. Site Access tokens need the DEVICE_DATA scope. Reconfigure the entry and approve both scopes, or turn off per-device telemetry in the options. Site sensors keep working.
